_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). From Session 73 (live now): the CPL Assistant has three improvements — try a few questions and tell me what to tune. (1) Ask about a STATEWIDE credit (e.g. a statewide RE or firefighter recommendation): it should say it's available system-wide and point you to YOUR college's landing page, not one specific college. (2) Ask 'what credit can I get for an EMT license?': it should LIST the eligible course titles + units, not just a number. (3) Ask a broad 'which colleges give credit for X': it should ASK whether you want a specific region or all options before showing a long list.

Also fixed Session 73: the assistant's college CPL landing-page links were broken/stale (San Diego Miramar pointed at the wrong code). They're now synced from the MAP College Landing Page API and auto-refresh weekly, so they should match map.rccd.edu/cpllandingpages.
